title: Spell haste does not shorten channeled spells (designer: not a bug)
claim: Spell haste does not shorten channels such as Mind Flay, Drain Life, Evocation and Wrack: Mind Flay stays 3.0 s at 10% or 50% haste.
detail: Bug #437 reported channels ignore spell haste; Aidan Moon (Blizzard designer) closed it as Not A Bug on Oct 26. Channels behave like DoTs, which are not hasted either. Spell haste still lowers cast times and the GCD (n:20261018-spell-haste-lowers-gcd), so haste gear speeds up Shadow Bolt/Frostbolt/Smite casters but not Mind Flay or Drain Life leveling rotations.

title: Warlock: Curse/Bane of Agony ticks now follow current spell power; Amplify Curse snapshots
claim: Agony ticks are rescripted to update to the caster's current spell power every tick (no longer snapshot at the first tick), while Amplify Curse is snapshotted at cast.
detail: Aidan Moon on #398 (Oct 26): Agony rolls its rounding once and reuses it, which is intended; Blizzard added scripting so every tick adjusts to the caster's spell power. Issue closed as Fixed. For leveling: swapping in spell power gear or trinkets mid-DoT now counts; Amplify Curse must be active when you cast.

title: Night Elf Shadowmeld does not enable stealth openers (intended)
claim: Shadowmeld does not count as Stealth for openers: Ambush, Cheap Shot, Garrote, Pounce and Ravage can't be used from Shadowmeld.
detail: Bug #366 closed Oct 26 by Aidan Moon: "Not A Bug. Intentional to make not grant Stealth for the purposes of openers." Night Elf Rogues and Druids can't re-open from Shadowmeld mid-fight; plan restealth/Prowl as in Era.

title: Layering: groups stay together on boats/zeppelins and entering/leaving capitals (fix for launch); group joins still swap layers
claim: Blizzard (Clay Stone, Oct 23) is fixing ahead of launch: players are no longer split into different layers after a boat/zeppelin loading screen, and large groups are no longer layered apart entering or leaving capital cities.
detail: Statement from WoW Forever associate production director Clay Stone to GameSpot. Not addressed: joining a group still moves you to the leader's layer, zone-border layer swaps and World Refresh (3-minute warning) stay. Layering stays at launch. For leveling: group travel by boat is safe for duos; still expect a layer swap (and respawned/depleted mobs) on group invite and at some zone borders (n:20261020-layer-swap-group-zone-border).

title: Live client installs to World of Warcraft\_forever_ and serves build 1.60.1.70532
claim: The WoW Forever live client is pre-installable now; it installs to World of Warcraft\_forever_ (sharing Data with _classic_beta_) and the live product serves build 1.60.1.70532, the last beta build.
detail: Forum report (Oct 22) of the _forever_ folder, ~12 GB pre-install; wowforeverbuilds (Oct 26) reads build 70532 from Blizzard's version service and gives fixes for a greyed-out Install button (right account, old Battle.net layout, or Battle.net.exe --game=WoWF --install). The project's test PC already has World of Warcraft\_forever_ with Glide in Interface\AddOns. Glide's addon write-back target should move from _classic_beta_ to _forever_.

title: ForeverDB addon will publish crowdsourced XP/hour per zone and level from launch
claim: ForeverDB's addon (0.48-0.49, Oct 25) times each level in active play and records quest turn-ins; from Nov 4 foreverdb.net/leveling-route shows the median XP/hour of players who spent most of a level in each zone.
detail: Away, dead and city/inn resting time is excluded; data is anonymous (random code). Single-player figures are flagged 'Not confirmed'. Until data arrives the page lists level-range estimates only. No JSON/API published. A post-launch check of measured XP/hour by zone and level for the coach's route model.

title: Final beta build: Deep Wounds, Windfury and Revelation procs reported not firing
claim: On the final beta client, Deep Wounds did not proc from any crit, and players reported Windfury Weapon and the Revelation enchant not proccing either; all had worked earlier in beta.
detail: Bug #434 (Oct 23, video), comments Oct 23-25. Possibly a final-client regression affecting proc effects generally; no Blizzard answer yet. The live client is the same build (70532), so check procs on day 1 before relying on Windfury/Deep Wounds damage in leveling estimates.

title: Group cave farming at level 15: about 25k XP/hour for a 5-man, roughly half a good quester's pace
claim: One beta tester reports a 5-player group farming fast-respawning caves in Darkshore/Westfall at level 15 earns about 25,000 XP/hour, about 50% slower than a strong quester, with no copper drops.
detail: Forum thread 'Why are hyperspawn cave killing groups ok' (Oct 26), single unverified claim; no cave names or respawn timers. Useful only as a ceiling check: questing stays faster.

title: Paladin: Righteous Fury learned at level 10 (was 16), hotfix
claim: Righteous Fury is now learned at level 10 instead of 16 (server hotfix on the last beta build, carried into live build 70532).
detail: Read from the public hotfix listing by two independent trackers: foreverchanges.pro (first seen Oct 23) and wowclassicforever.info (Oct 24 entry). Not in Blizzard's notes. Useful for Prot/Ret threat and mana while leveling.

title: Paladin: Champion of the Light back to 20/40/60% of Intellect (hotfix)
claim: Champion of the Light (level 35 talent) scales at 20/40/60% of Intellect in the live client data (1.60.1.70532), up from the 10/20/30% in the Oct 15 notes.
detail: Three readers of the client hotfix data agree on 20/40/60% (ForeverDB's 70532 changelog and live-client article, foreverchanges.pro, wowclassicforever.info); they disagree on the date (Oct 16 vs Oct 20). It conflicts with Blizzard's Oct 15 notes and the Paladin deep dive ("up to 30%"). Not verified in game; check the tooltip on launch.
